easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
